changes: DMG window effects that begin at the far left of a scanline now line up much more closely with real hardware, with fewer stale tiles and one-pixel seams.
Reference-frame agreement for the tested DMG timing set rose 4.76% overall; the WX 4, 5 and 6 edge cases improved 74.70%, 56.98% and 48.31% respectively.
The six-game performance check stayed checksum-identical and measured 1.6% more available processing headroom, especially useful for shader, audio and interface work.
Save states now remember the screen's in-progress drawing step, so snapshots taken during a tricky window effect resume cleanly.
All 58 project tests pass and the existing audio timing results are unchanged; the larger PPU/APU accuracy work is being held for v3.0.0.
